title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
authors: Amey Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Ashish Panwar; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav S. Gulavani; Alexey Tumanov; Ramachandran Ramjee
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: Microsoft Research India, Georgia Institute of Technology
research_focus: Continuous batching, LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: LLM inference scheduling faces a fundamental throughput-latency tradeoff: prefill-prioritizing schedulers (vLLM, Orca) boost throughput but cause multi-second generation stalls that violate TBT SLOs, while decode-prioritizing schedulers (FasterTransformer) keep TBT low but under-utilize compute. Pipeline-parallel deployments further suffer from pipeline bubbles caused by heterogeneous prefill and decode batch execution times.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理排程面臨吞吐量與延遲的根本權衡：prefill-prioritizing scheduler（如 vLLM、Orca）提升吞吐量但會造成數秒級的 generation stall，違反 TBT SLO；decode-prioritizing scheduler（如 FasterTransformer）雖維持低 TBT 但 GPU 計算利用率偏低；pipeline parallel 部署更受 prefill 與 decode batch 執行時間差異所致的 pipeline bubble 困擾。

key_innovation.en: Sarathi-Serve introduces chunked-prefills — splitting a prefill into near-equal-sized token chunks — combined with stall-free batching that adds new requests to a running batch without pausing on-going decodes. By forming near-uniform hybrid batches under a tunable per-iteration token budget (selected via Vidur-based profiling), it simultaneously achieves high throughput, low TBT tail latency, and reduced pipeline bubbles.
key_innovation.zh: Sarathi-Serve 提出 chunked-prefills，將 prefill 切分成大小近似的 token chunk，並結合 stall-free batching：在不暫停進行中 decode 的前提下將新請求加入正在執行的 batch；透過可調的每 iteration token budget（以 Vidur profile 決定），形成近乎均勻的 hybrid batch，同時達到高吞吐量、低 TBT tail latency 與更少的 pipeline bubble。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.6x higher serving capacity for Mistral-7B on a single A100; up to 3.7x higher capacity for Yi-34B on two A100s; up to 5.6x end-to-end gain for Falcon-180B with pipeline parallelism on commodity Ethernet.
key_improvements.zh: Mistral-7B 於單顆 A100 上服務容量提升最多 2.6x；Yi-34B 於兩顆 A100 提升最多 3.7x；Falcon-180B 在以一般 Ethernet 連線的 pipeline parallel 部署下端到端容量提升最多 5.6x。

traffic_pattern: Continuous Batching, Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (token budget chosen via Vidur profiling; paper reports serving capacity and P99 TBT rather than per-iteration latency MAPE)

scope_assumptions.en: Built atop vLLM v0.x with FlashAttention v2 / FlashInfer kernels for paged chunked-prefill; token budget assumes a one-time offline profile of (model, hardware, SLO) and is fixed at deployment; tile-quantization effects forced careful chunk-size selection (chunk 257 increased prefill time 32% versus 256); long-context evaluation filters requests above 8192 (sharegpt4) or 16384 (arxiv_summarization) tokens; pipeline-parallel deployments evaluated only on Falcon-180B over commodity Ethernet at 100 Gbps; KV cache treatment inherits vLLM PagedAttention assumptions (HBM only).
scope_assumptions.zh: 建構於 vLLM v0.x 並使用 FlashAttention v2 / FlashInfer kernel 支援 paged chunked-prefill；token budget 假設一次性離線 profile（model、hardware、SLO）並於部署時固定；tile-quantization 效應使 chunk size 選擇必須謹慎（chunk size 257 較 256 增加 32% prefill 時間）；長 context 評估過濾掉 8192（sharegpt4）或 16384（arxiv_summarization）以上的請求；pipeline parallel 部署僅於 Falcon-180B 以 100 Gbps Ethernet 評估；KV cache 處理沿用 vLLM PagedAttention 的 HBM-only 假設。
